title: Top-Account Release Window Orchestrator (TARWO): intake, risk-scoring, and slot allocation
creator: Lina Zhao
description:
Problem: High-touch enterprise accounts frequently request fast-tracked roadmap changes or escalations that require coordinated release windows, scoped deliverables, and SLA commitments. Current intake oscillates between ad-hoc Slack threads, spreadsheet queues, and one-off PM/SE alignments which leads to missed expectations, unclear commitments, and engineering context loss.

Goal: Build the "Top-Account Release Window Orchestrator (TARWO)" playbook and lightweight intake workflow to: 1) capture VIP asks consistently, 2) score requests by risk & revenue impact within 24 hours, 3) allocate constrained sprint/release slots using a deterministic policy, and 4) produce a compact commitment packet for legal/CS/SE to sign off. TARWO should reduce time-to-decision for escalations to <= 72 hours and increase SLA adherence for top accounts by 30% over the next two quarters.
acceptance_criteria: Standardized intake form deployed (Confluence + embedded form / CRM webhook) and linked from AE/CS playbook
Automated scoring engine prototype calculates impact/risk score and surfaces top-3 triage recommendations
Release slot allocator shows available windows and recommends 1 best-fit slot based on capacity, dependencies, and customer priority
Commitment packet template (scope, rollout plan, rollback criteria, SLA language) available and reviewed by legal and CS
Pilot completes with 3 active enterprise customers and we meet 72-hour decision SLA for >= 80% of pilot requests
tasks: Design intake form fields and required attachments (PM + CS)
Define scoring rubric: revenue impact, regulatory risk, engineering effort, rollback complexity, cross-team dependencies
Implement a minimal scoring lambda that returns a normalized score and triage bucket
Create a release-slot allocator UI mock in Console (read-only for pilot) and integration spec for routing to Eng capacity team
Draft commitment packet template and run legal/CS review
Run a 4-week pilot with CS, AE, and 3 enterprise customers; collect metrics and qualitative feedback
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Scoring rubric gamed by sales/CS to jump queue -> Mitigation: require manager sign-off + automated cross-checks against contract terms
Risk: Engineering capacity mis-estimated -> Mitigation: integrate with Dedicated capacity telemetry and require ENG owner approval for slot allocation
Risk: Legal/contract friction on SLA wording -> Mitigation: templates with optional clauses and pre-approved fallback language
metrics: Time from intake submission to decision (target <= 72h)
Percent of pilot escalations meeting committed SLA (target +30% improvement vs baseline)
Number of release windows consumed vs reserved (capacity utilization metric)
Qualitative CS/AEs satisfaction score for the intake process (target >= 4/5)

notes: We should reuse components from PM-4921 intake framework where possible to avoid duplicating approval flows.
Consider an MVP that uses a lightweight Google Form + Zapier webhook into the scoring lambda to expedite pilot launch.
Longer-term: integrate TARWO with roadmap calendar and billing to automate credits/compensation if SLA breached.
